note: order_id param exercised w/ an equity order id (no option orders exist to harvest) - expect not-found/empty.

response.guide: Describe orders by chain_symbol, opening_strategy or closing_strategy, state, quantity (with processed_quantity when partially filled), and premium; show id when cancellation may follow. Source chain_symbol from the response directly — never infer. Mention placed_agent when not 'user'. Recover the user-facing order type from type+trigger (limit+immediate=limit, market+immediate=market, limit+stop=stop_limit, market+stop=stop_market) and surface price for limit/stop_limit, stop_price for stop_limit/stop_market. is_replaceable=true marks orders eligible for replace_option_order (cancel-and-replace on the same contract). When next is non-empty more pages exist — call this tool again with cursor set to that value verbatim.
